params.description: filter by these ids of users assigned to investigate the customer (can be empty string to get unassigned)

params.description: label filter (if empty string then customers with no labels are returned)

params.name: minimum_avg_score
params.description: filter by avg_score >= the given value

params.name: maximum_avg_score
params.description: filter by avg_score <= the given value

params.name: minimum_max_score
params.description: filter by max_score >= the given value

params.name: maximum_max_score
params.description: filter by max_score <= the given value

params.name: minimum_vol
params.description: filter by volume >= the given value in USD

params.name: maximum_vol
params.description: filter by volume <= the given value in USD

params.name: first_tx_before
params.description: filter the earliest transaction time of this customer (ISO8601 datetime) <= the given date

params.name: first_tx_after
params.description: filter the earliest transaction time of this customer (ISO8601 datetime) >= the given date

params.name: last_tx_before
params.description: filter the latest transaction time of this customer (ISO8601 datetime) <= the given date

params.name: last_tx_after
params.description: filter the latest transaction time of this customer (ISO8601 datetime) >= the given date

params.name: last_queried_before
params.description: filter last_queried time of customer (ISO8601 datetime) <= the given date

params.name: last_queried_after
params.description: filter last_queried time of customer (ISO8601 datetime) >= the given date
